name: ingest
description:
YOUR PRIMARY TOOL FOR BUILDING LONG-TERM MEMORY. Automatically decides whether to CREATE, UPDATE, SUPERSEDE, or SKIP based on what you already know.

CALL AGGRESSIVELY — every time you encounter something worth remembering:
- User preferences, habits, or working style
- Technical decisions and WHY they were made
- Architecture patterns, library choices, configuration gotchas
- People, roles, relationships mentioned in conversation
- Project context: goals, constraints, deadlines, blockers
- Debugging insights: what caused a bug, what fixed it
- Tool/framework knowledge: 'X works well for Y', 'avoid Z because...'
- Domain knowledge: business rules, API behaviors, data models
- Corrections: 'user said X is wrong, Y is correct'

DO NOT CALL for: ephemeral task state (use plan tools), raw code (derivable from files), or content the user explicitly marks as temporary.

The prediction error gate handles dedup — calling too often is better than missing important information. If in doubt, ingest it.

RETURNS: action taken (Created/Updated/Superseded/Skipped) + entity_id.
Cost: ~15ms.

entity_name.description: Clean entity name (e.g. 'Ben Kearns', 'Ferrosa'). If omitted, extracted automatically from content via LLM or heuristic.

session_id.description: Caller session UUID retained as ingest provenance. It does not move an existing entity or override its type-defined storage scope.

source_fold_id.description: Optional: UUID of the fold (conversation thread) that produced this content. Omit or pass null if not in a fold context. DO NOT pass a file path — this field expects a fold UUID from start_fold, or null.

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.
